meta.source: YouApp System App (Figma), exported to PDF, Oct 2026

tokens.name: brand-primary-start
tokens.usage: Left stop of the Primary gradient (linear, left to right, into brand-primary-end). Primary buttons, active tab underline, progress fill, slider fill, app icon.

tokens.name: brand-primary-end
tokens.usage: Right stop of the Primary gradient. Same value as brand-indigo.

tokens.name: primary-pressed-start
tokens.usage: Left stop of the Primary button's pressed gradient. Sampled from the exported button page (PDF render), so treat as ±2 per channel.

tokens.name: primary-pressed-end
tokens.usage: Right stop of the Primary button's pressed gradient (sampled, ±2).

tokens.name: primary-loading-start
tokens.usage: Left stop of the Primary button's loading gradient (sampled, ±2).

tokens.name: primary-loading-end
tokens.usage: Right stop of the Primary button's loading gradient (sampled, ±2).

tokens.name: primary-disabled-start
tokens.usage: Left stop of the Primary button's disabled gradient (sampled, ±2). White label on it is 2.0:1 — acceptable only because disabled controls are exempt.

tokens.name: primary-disabled-end
tokens.usage: Right stop of the Primary button's disabled gradient (sampled, ±2).

tokens.name: brand-indigo
tokens.usage: Brand Indigo. Active labels (bottom nav, links such as a host's specialty line), icon accents (user-star, calendar-star). 12.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: brand-lavender
tokens.usage: Brand Lavender. Brand book colour; in the UI it appears only through the gradient. 4.0:1 on white, so not for small text.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Brand White. Default surface for screens, cards, inputs, dialogs and sheets; text and icons on the Primary gradient.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Brand Black. Dark backgrounds for the on-dark logo; dark browser chrome.

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Brand Gray. Brand book colour; neutral ground for the faded logo.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Info helper text and icon, 'Online' presence, Success toast border and icon. 4.8:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent-lavender-tint
tokens.usage: Halo behind the active bottom-nav icon.

tokens.name: surface-lavender
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track; pressed fill of Secondary (outline) buttons. ink reads 15.4:1 on it.

tokens.name: decor-lavender
tokens.usage: Decorative oversized category words (Dance, Stay, Eat, Pay…). Never for readable text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface tokens (17.7:1 on white). Titles, field values, button labels on neutral buttons, all UI icons.

tokens.name: ink-sheet
tokens.usage: Titles and body in bottom sheets and the home indicator bar (18.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white and gray-100: handles (@janedoe), dates, field subtitles, list subtitles (6.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, inactive bottom-nav labels and icons, disabled labels. Source pair is 3.0:1 on white — fails 4.5:1 for body text; kept exact from the source.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of disabled inputs and disabled Tertiary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px border of inputs, cards, chips, review cards; dividers; progress and slider tracks; disabled input fill.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of Tertiary and Ghost buttons; selected row in radio lists; slider-captcha track.

tokens.name: overlay-ink-50
tokens.usage: brand-black at 50%: fill of the neutral confirmation toast ('Report has been sent') and push-notification previews, with white text. On a white screen that is 3.3:1 — kept exact from the source; holds only for the 16px semibold label it carries.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive buttons, required asterisk, Failed toast border and icon, error text. 5.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of Destructive outline buttons.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of Destructive buttons. danger reads 4.8:1 on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success helper icon and text. 3.4:1 on white: use at 14px semibold or larger, always with the check icon.

tokens.name: pending
tokens.usage: Pending toast border and clock icon, pending helper text. 2.4:1 on white — only as icon and border colour beside ink text; kept exact from the source.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Large titles, OTP digits, rating value in sheets.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Big button labels, field titles, bottom-sheet titles, tab labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small button labels, field subtitles, names on cards, dialog actions.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet body copy, bottom-nav labels (500).
styles.sample: Please make sure to input your phone number before you apply as a host.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper and info text, review body, handles, dates.

spacing.note: Inferred from component padding in the source; the Figma file has no spacing page.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside helper text; between label and asterisk.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between field and its helper row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked fields and list rows; toast inner gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of inputs, cards, toasts; screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; bottom-sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Big button horizontal padding; gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, toasts, push notifications, sheet primary button.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards (review card), puzzle image, rating chip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All Big and Small buttons, segmented control, tabs indicator, progress bars.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of Big buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of single-line inputs and toasts.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of Small buttons (Glass Small is 40px).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.
